thread:
jake_sales: FYI the ratecard v2026.04 push just flipped the grandfathering logic in the quote tool. Some legacy commit customers are seeing new "promo override" line items on generated quotes. Not good. @nina_dealdesk can you pause the auto-quote pipeline?

nina_dealdesk: On it. Pausing the pipeline now. Which customers are impacted? Any live POs already created?

jake_sales: So far noticed on two accounts: Meridian Health (PO created this morning) and ByteLabs (quote draft only). Meridian's PO ID: PO-55912. The issue appears to be that `ratecard.v2026.04.grandfathering.enabled` defaulted to `false` which causes promo rules to re-evaluate.

emily_prodops: Thanks for flagging. That default flip was from my config cleanup PR. I didn't realize it would touch the quote generator. Reverting the default is straightforward but we should gate with a release note / rollback.

nina_dealdesk: Meridian has signed the PO. If we change pricing retroactively we'll need to issue a credit + corrected invoice. @tan_vi_admin can Billing reissue without affecting commit accounting?

tan_vi_admin: Billing here. We can reissue and create a credit memo. Need support ticket referencing the ratecard change and authorization from Deal Desk. Also need the corrected line items. If the adjusted total is lower, we'll process a one-time credit; if higher, reach out to legal for amendment.

jake_sales: For Meridian corrected line items (draft):
```
- Dedicated: 4x A100 (monthly) - base $36,000
- Legacy commit grandfathering discount - 15% - amount -$5,400
- Subtotal: $30,600
- Tax: $2,754
- Total: $33,354
```
Current incorrect invoice added a "POC promo" -10% on top of commit discount, bringing total down to $30k. We should restore grandfathering-only pricing.

emily_prodops: OK I'm reverting the config in staging and will push hotfix to prod in ~15min. I'll also add a changelog entry for ratecard v2026.04 noting the change in `grandfathering` default.

nina_dealdesk: Authorizing credit issuance for Meridian under "ratecard hotpatch" exception. Authorization code: `AUTH-RC-09`. Updating deal desk tracker.

tan_vi_admin: Received `AUTH-RC-09`. Creating credit memo draft CM-2026-4410 and invoice reissue INV-2026-9982 (pending). Will tag legal only if customer owes more.

emily_prodops: Hotfix deployed to prod. Verified quote generator respects grandfathering flag now. Rolling back the default and adding an integration test to catch this.

jake_sales: Thanks all. I'll notify Meridian with a short explanation and attach corrected invoice once Billing marks INV-2026-9982 final. Please leave a note in the ticket that this is not a permanent rate change. :thumbsup:

tan_vi_admin: Will do. Ticket TKT-2026-8812 updated and audit note added. Closing pipeline pause now that patch is live.

nina_dealdesk: Pipeline unpaused. Monitor for any more hits and ping if we see anomalies.

jake_sales: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Let's also add a brief internal announcement in #sales about the v2026.04 nuance so field teams don't get surprised. :speaker:
